subject: Re: Renewal evidence — staggered delivery windows & procurement checkpoints
messages:
From: Elena Morales <procurement@greenlinehealth.com>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwood.com>
Cc: Tariq Farouk <tariq.farouk@greenlinehealth.com>
Date: Mon, 16 Nov 2026 11:02:00 -0500
Subject: Request: SOC 2 Type II, interim attestation & procurement delivery schedule

Hi Sofia,

Hope you’re well. Greenline’s renewal is up Jan 15, 2027 and procurement needs to confirm we have acceptable security evidence before our renewal committee meets Dec 15. Can you confirm the following:

1) Latest SOC 2 Type II report (date range covered) and whether you can provide an interim attestation or bridge letter covering the gap between the last Type II and our renewal cutoff.
2) Whether your auditor can provide a short coverage letter that specifically states the audit period covered and any exceptions (if present).
3) A realistic, staggered delivery timeline for the materials we need for procurement in time for our gating date (Dec 15):
   - Priority 1 (must have by Nov 30): SOC 2 summary, scope, point of contact for auditor
   - Priority 2 (must have by Dec 8): Interim attestation/bridge wording or auditor letter
   - Priority 3 (Dec 15): Full evidence pack (control narratives, policy extracts) or confirmation of delivery window for full pack

Also, procurement will need a copy of any previous SOC 2 report you reference (PDF), and a single-file interim attestation if available. We may route the PO only after we get the interim attestation and auditor contact for quick follow-up.

Thanks — can you confirm timelines by EOD Wednesday?

Best,
Elena Morales
Senior Procurement Manager
Greenline Health

Attachment(s): none

From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwood.com>
To: Elena Morales <procurement@greenlinehealth.com>
Cc: Tariq Farouk <tariq.farouk@greenlinehealth.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 18 Nov 2026 09:16:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Request: SOC 2 Type II, interim attestation & procurement delivery schedule

Elena — thanks for the clear checklist. We can meet your gating needs; below is our proposed plan and a couple clarifying asks.

Planned delivery (provisional):
- By Nov 24: SOC 2 Type II executive summary & PDF of last Type II (2024 report) — includes date range and scope.
- By Dec 6: Interim attestation / auditor coverage letter (single PDF) that covers interim period through 2026-12-31.
- By Dec 15: Full evidence pack or a confirmed schedule for delivery of remaining artifacts (control narratives, policies).

Clarifying asks:
- Is Greenline able to accept an auditor-provided coverage letter as an interim artifact for procurement sign-off? If not, please specify the minimum fields the letter must include (audit period, scope, auditor signature, and statement of coverage).
- Do you require a signed letter on auditor letterhead, or will a signed PDF from us routed through your portal suffice?

Internal notes: looping in Marissa (Security) to prepare the interim-attestation and Ben (Account lead) to shadow timing for procurement. We will upload materials to the shared Drive (link below) and push the interim attestation to you once Marissa confirms wording.

Links: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/0Aq-Redwood/Greenline-Evidence
DocuSign PO (if needed): https://docusign.com/link/GL-PO-9823

Sofia Ivanova
Senior Sales Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachment(s): Redwood_SOC2_TypeII_2024.pdf (provision to be uploaded by 11/24)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 14:08:00 -0500
Subject: RE: Request: SOC 2 Type II, interim attestation & procurement delivery schedule

Thanks Sofia — I can take the attestation. Quick status + recommended phrasing:

Status:
- Auditor (Brightline CPA) confirmed they can provide a coverage letter. They will not re-audit; they will provide a signed letter confirming the period covered by the last Type II and stating no material changes to the control environment through 2026-12-31 (standard wording).
- I have the 2024 Type II PDF ready; will upload to the Drive on Monday 11/22.

Proposed interim-attestation (short form):
"Brightline CPA has performed a SOC 2 Type II examination for Redwood Inference covering the period 2024-01-01 to 2024-12-31. Based on their procedures and subsequent inquiries, Brightline confirms that, to the best of their knowledge, there are no material changes to Redwood's control environment through 2026-12-31 that would alter the scope of the prior examination."

Delivery commitments (internal):
- 2026-11-22: Upload 2024 Type II PDF to Drive (Priority 1)
- 2026-12-06: Interim attestation/coverage letter from Brightline (Priority 2)
- 2026-12-15: Full evidence pack or explicit delivery schedule for remaining artifacts (Priority 3)

Note — if Greenline requires the auditor to address a specific control area in the coverage letter, we need that ask by 11/24. Otherwise we proceed with standard coverage language.

Marissa Cole
Head of Trust & Compliance
Redwood Inference

Attachment(s): none

From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwood.com>
To: Elena Morales <procurement@greenlinehealth.com>, Tariq Farouk <tariq.farouk@greenlinehealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 29 Nov 2026 09:45:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Request: SOC 2 Type II, interim attestation & procurement delivery schedule

Hi Elena / Tariq — follow-up and confirmation per our internal commitments below. Thanks for the patience while we coordinated with the auditor.

What we are delivering:
- 2026-11-22: 2024 SOC 2 Type II (executive summary + full PDF) — uploaded to Drive.
- 2026-12-06: Interim attestation / auditor coverage letter (Brightline CPA) in single signed PDF: "interim-attestation-coverage-letter_2026-12-31.pdf". This will include the audit period and statement of no material changes through 2026-12-31.
- 2026-12-15: Full evidence pack or a clearly scoped delivery schedule for remaining artifacts (control narratives, sample evidence exports).

Procurement gating: if Greenline can accept the auditor coverage letter (signed PDF on Brightline letterhead) for preliminary PO routing, we will prioritize getting that to you on 12/06. If you require additional fields in that letter, please send the list by 11/30 so we can request the specific language from Brightline.

Attachments (for your review):
- Redwood_SOC2_TypeII_2024.pdf (already uploaded)
- interim-attestation-coverage-letter_2026-12-31.pdf (pending auditor signature, targeted 12/06)

Next steps:
- Elena: confirm whether the Brightline coverage letter format suffices for procurement sign-off.
- Tariq: if procurement has a PO timing preference (we heard Dec 10–12 as common), let us know and we’ll align.

Thanks — will keep you posted the moment we have the signed attestation.

Best,
Sofia Ivanova
Senior Sales Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachment(s): Redwood_SOC2_TypeII_2024.pdf (link), interim-attestation-coverage-letter_2026-12-31.pdf (pending)"
